leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the white-space property to control text wrapping behavior in CSS
Configure the text-overflow property to handle overflowing text content
Implement ellipsis truncation for single-line text elements
Construct CSS rules that combine white-space and text-overflow for specific text display scenarios
Manipulate text layout by adjusting white-space values like nowrap, pre, and normal
Control text overflow behavior using values such as clip and ellipsis
Initialize proper container constraints to make text-overflow effects visible
